reference.method: Unmodified official Linux executable with original KFM data, authored QA AssertInput, and independently authored ignorehitpause VarSet/ChangeAnim probes. Selected samples compare CNS reads with post-tick externally observable animation clocks.

scope: Standing KFM attacks at localcoord 320; ordinary pause, same-action reset, different-action reset, repeated resets, loop boundaries and reset-to-first-element. External clocks, CNS reads and sprite dimensions/axis offsets are separate observations. No claim for every pause/controller combination.
